what: Proof of concept outside the campaign: separate journal and directory, train only. Candidates do not enter the campaign and are not in this repository. See docs/poc.md.

researcher.limit: 3 candidates, tuned on a fixed 100-example subset of train

stand: VM with 2 vCPU and 8 GB RAM, real train evaluator, runner, metric, PostgreSQL 16.4 and Trino 483

candidates.change: UPDATE FROM to MERGE for Trino, array functions

researcher_cost.note: Priced from the subagent's transcript, not billed. A lower bound for the campaign: these are the easiest steps, and the campaign runs on Hermes.

holdout_note: Only these totals were recorded; per-example failures were not read, so the holdout stays usable for the finalists.
